content:
sarah (sales): FYI inbound from ACME infra — they want a sealed/offline onboarding plan and clarity on the sideload workflow + rollback SLA.
customer-rep: hey team, we need to prove we can onboard 3 tenants into an isolated DC. no internet, only USB transfer allowed. can you confirm package acceptance steps and how upgrades look?
anya (solutions): short answer: yes, but there are constraints. two flows: 1) full offline bundle (signed artifacts + sbom) 2) delta bundles for follow-up patches. which one are you validating for the POC?
customer-rep: need both. test initial install + one patch/upgrade during the week-long trial. also pricing question: is there an extra charge for offline delta delivery + engineer support?
sarah (sales): pricing: offline delivery + packaging is an add-on; we typically quote a one-time packaging fee + per-pipeline sign/validation run. i'll pull numbers but assume initial packaging effort (2-3 eng days) and a small monthly offline retention fee.
mike (eng): technical: bundles are tarballs signed by our release key. for offline installs we recommend the chunked bundle to avoid large USB limits. process is: verify signature -> run preflight -> install -> register with local license validator. sample verify command:```sh
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify public.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
raj (security): note: customer requires HSM-based key custody on their side for production. for POC we can use our signing with an auditable SBOM and reproducible build instructions. if they insist on customer-controlled signing, we'll need an onboarding window to exchange keys and update CI.
anya (solutions): for delta patches the constraints: - patches must be binary-compatible with deployed quantization profiles - deltas are generated as diffs against the pinned model bundle - upgrades are atomic but we allow staged rollbacks within 15 minutes by keeping the previous bundle cached.
customer-rep: rollback SLA? their ops run strict change windows. what happens if a patch breaks inference quality?
mike (eng): rollback flow: agent detects crash or regression signals (via health check and token-level error rates) -> controller triggers revert -> old bundle re-mounted. target mean time to revert ~5-10 min in our test bench. human approval can be required depending on the policy.
sarah (sales): ops/price implication: if they want guaranteed revert time SLA and a warm pool of backups we include Dedicated warm-storage option (monthly). otherwise it's included in POC but without SLA credits.
anya (solutions): practical checklist for POC: 1) customer provides a build VM + 2x USB sticks 2) exchange our public signing key 3) confirm firewall rules for license-nginx (just egress to license validation host via jumpbox) OR we provide an offline license file 4) test patch cycle (create delta, sign, apply, revert).
customer-rep: are there any cert lifetime issues for the offline license file? ops worried about cert rotation mid-contract.
raj (security): offline license files are signed JWTs with long expiry by default for POCs. for production we require short-lived certs + automated rotation. if they can't do rotation, we can set up a customer-side KMS to sign periodic tokens.
mike (eng): one more gotcha: model quantization bundles may change size significantly; our chunker has a 4GB chunk target but can be tuned. bring larger media if you have big models.
anya (solutions): deployment runbook we'll bring: preflight checklist, precomputed file checksums, signature verification, and step-by-step rollback commands. also a one-page operator guide for the on-call team.
sarah (sales): i'll draft an SOW: packaging fee estimate, two-day onsite remote runbook support, one patch cycle included. anyone want to add engineering caveats before i send to procurement?
mike (eng): add: if they request customer signing with HSM we need 5 business days to validate CI changes.
raj (security): include a note about SBOM retention and export controls: no model weights leave their network in offline mode.
deploy-bot: build/packager v3.4.2: generated offline bundle 2468101212-ACME-testbundle.tar.gz (checksum: sha256:ab12...ef34)
customer-rep: perfect — we'll schedule the POC window next Tuesday. pls send the runbook and the SOW. :thumbsup:
anya (solutions): sending runbook + minimal commands in DM now. SOW draft by EOD.
sarah (sales): thanks all — i'll prepare pricing + SOW and loop in legal for export/contract language. tagging this as POC:offline-onprem for tracking. :white_check_mark:
